01-accounts-access: Users, scoped roles, memberships, and login sessions.
02-mall-shop-directory: Malls, floors, shop locations, facilities, and opening hours.
03-products-catalogue: Shared products and variants, shop listings, images, and optional inventory.
04-maps-navigation: Versioned floor maps, routing graphs, QR anchors, vertical connectors, and AR references.
05-purchase-verification: Recorded purchases and single-use purchase evidence for product reviews.
06-reviews-moderation: Normal and purchase-verified reviews, replies, reports, and moderation history.
07-favourites-preferences: Saved shops, saved listings, and user interface/navigation preferences.
08-chatbot-rag: Conversations, versioned knowledge, retrieval citations, and product recommendations.
09-analytics-reports: Defined metrics, reproducible snapshots, monthly reports, and optional forecasts.

APP_USER.name: APP_USER
APP_USER.description: One account across all customer, shop, and mall interfaces.

columns.name: phone
columns.description: Normalized phone number; unique when present.

columns.name: password_hash
columns.description: Password hash from the authentication library, never plaintext.

checks: At least one of email or phone is present for an active account.
Anonymized accounts retain their ID for history; remove personal fields and disable authentication.
Guest browsing creates no APP_USER row. Email/phone login is the proposed initial authentication model.

ROLE.name: ROLE
ROLE.description: Role catalogue with an explicit authorization scope.

columns.name: code
columns.description: Example customer, platform_admin, mall_admin, shop_owner, shop_staff.

checks: Role scope is immutable after assignments exist.
A role name alone never grants access to every mall or shop.

USER_ROLE.name: USER_ROLE
checks: Composite primary key (user_id, role_id). ROLE.scope_type must be platform.

MALL_MEMBERSHIP.name: MALL_MEMBERSHIP
MALL_MEMBERSHIP.description: A user with one particular role within one mall.
checks: ROLE.scope_type must be mall.

SHOP_MEMBERSHIP.name: SHOP_MEMBERSHIP
SHOP_MEMBERSHIP.description: A user with one particular role within one shop.
checks: ROLE.scope_type must be shop.

AUTH_SESSION.name: AUTH_SESSION
AUTH_SESSION.description: Revocable login sessions; not route sessions.

columns.name: refresh_token_hash
columns.description: Digest of a high-entropy refresh credential.

checks: expires_at > created_at. Never save a raw refresh token.

MALL.name: MALL
MALL.description: A mall boundary used for directory, map, and permission ownership.

FLOOR.name: FLOOR
FLOOR.description: Physical level of a mall, independent of any map version.

columns.name: code
columns.description: Stable code such as B1 or F2.

columns.name: sort_order
columns.description: Display order, not a routing cost.

columns.name: elevation_m
columns.description: Elevation relative to the mall origin, in metres.

SHOP_CATEGORY.name: SHOP_CATEGORY
SHOP_CATEGORY.description: Shop classification such as food, clothing, or electronics.
checks: The parent hierarchy must be acyclic; a category cannot be its own parent.

SHOP.name: SHOP
SHOP.description: One shop business in one mall; locations are represented separately.

columns.name: slug
columns.description: URL slug unique within its mall.

SHOP_UNIT.name: SHOP_UNIT
SHOP_UNIT.description: A physical unit occupied by a shop; a shop can occupy several floors.

columns.name: unit_code
columns.description: Physical unit code, unique on its floor.

checks: SHOP.mall_id must equal FLOOR.mall_id.
area_sq_m is positive when present. This baseline stores current occupancy; tenant history needs a separate lease model.

SHOP_OPENING_HOUR.name: SHOP_OPENING_HOUR
SHOP_OPENING_HOUR.description: Weekly opening intervals, including split opening periods.

columns.name: opens_at
columns.description: Opening time in the mall timezone.

columns.name: closes_at
columns.description: Closing time in the mall timezone.

checks: Composite primary key (shop_id, weekday, interval_no). weekday between 1 and 7; interval_no > 0.
Intervals cannot overlap; no intervals on a day means closed. A 24-hour interval uses equal times and closes_next_day=true.
Holiday exceptions are outside this baseline and must not be inferred from weekly hours.

FACILITY.name: FACILITY
FACILITY.description: Public destinations such as toilets, information desks, or prayer rooms.

columns.name: facility_type
columns.description: toilet, prayer_room, information, exit, or other.

columns.name: is_accessible
columns.description: Whether the destination itself is accessible.

PRODUCT_CATEGORY.name: PRODUCT_CATEGORY
PRODUCT_CATEGORY.description: Searchable product taxonomy; distinct from shop categories.
checks: Parent links form an acyclic hierarchy.

PRODUCT.name: PRODUCT
PRODUCT.description: Shared product definition that can be sold by multiple shops.
checks: Brand/name are not assumed globally unique. Establish who may create or merge shared products.

PRODUCT_VARIANT.name: PRODUCT_VARIANT
PRODUCT_VARIANT.description: A purchasable version such as size, volume, or colour.

columns.name: variant_code
columns.description: Code unique within the product; use default when no variants exist.

columns.name: attributes_json
columns.description: Display attributes; important searchable fields may later be normalized.

SHOP_PRODUCT.name: SHOP_PRODUCT
SHOP_PRODUCT.description: A shop-specific listing and price for one product variant.

columns.name: shop_product_id
columns.description: Listing identifier used by reviews and favourites.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: ISO currency code; initial proposal BDT.

checks: price_amount >= 0. Use a fixed decimal representation for money.
Availability is owner-maintained unless the optional inventory workflow is implemented.

PRODUCT_IMAGE.name: PRODUCT_IMAGE
PRODUCT_IMAGE.description: Shared product images ordered for presentation.

columns.name: object_key
columns.description: Managed image storage location, not an expiring signed URL.

INVENTORY_BALANCE.name: INVENTORY_BALANCE
INVENTORY_BALANCE.description: Optional latest inventory snapshot for a listing.
checks: 0 <= quantity_reserved <= quantity_on_hand.
This snapshot is not a stock movement ledger. Do not claim transaction-safe inventory without a separate stock/reservation workflow.

MAP_VERSION.name: MAP_VERSION
MAP_VERSION.description: One immutable published routing/map dataset covering a mall.

columns.name: coordinate_frame
columns.description: Declared mall-local frame name and convention.

checks: At most one published version per mall, using a conditional unique index.
All node coordinates use metres: x and y horizontal, z up. The mall origin and axis alignment are documented before mapping.
Published versions are immutable. Publish a replacement atomically; keep retired data for active sessions/history.

FLOOR_MAP.name: FLOOR_MAP
FLOOR_MAP.description: Visual map assets and image-to-world transform for a floor/version.

columns.name: plan_2d_key
columns.description: Floor plan image or vector storage key.

columns.name: pixel_origin_x
columns.description: Image pixel x corresponding to transform origin.

columns.name: pixel_origin_y
columns.description: Image pixel y corresponding to transform origin.

columns.name: rotation_deg
columns.description: Counterclockwise image-to-world rotation after y-axis flip.

columns.name: world_origin_x_m
columns.description: World x of the image transform origin.

columns.name: world_origin_y_m
columns.description: World y of the image transform origin.

checks: metres_per_pixel > 0. FLOOR.mall_id must equal MAP_VERSION.mall_id.
This affine transform assumes uniform scale and no skew; rectification is a map preparation task.

NAVIGATION_NODE.name: NAVIGATION_NODE
NAVIGATION_NODE.description: Graph vertex at a shop entrance, corridor junction, checkpoint, or connector.

columns.name: node_code
columns.description: Human-readable code unique in the version.

columns.name: node_type
columns.description: junction, entrance, checkpoint, connector, or facility.

columns.name: is_accessible
columns.description: Whether accessible routing can use this node.

checks: Require a FLOOR_MAP for this (map_version_id, floor_id) using a composite FK.

VERTICAL_CONNECTOR.name: VERTICAL_CONNECTOR
VERTICAL_CONNECTOR.description: Physical staircase, lift, or escalator shared across map versions.

CONNECTOR_STOP.name: CONNECTOR_STOP
CONNECTOR_STOP.description: Graph location where a vertical connector serves a floor in one version.
checks: Node version and floor must match the stop; connector, floor, and map must belong to the same mall.

NAVIGATION_EDGE.name: NAVIGATION_EDGE
NAVIGATION_EDGE.description: A directed traversable connection; reverse travel needs a second edge.

columns.name: connector_id
columns.description: Required for a cross-floor connector edge.

columns.name: expected_seconds
columns.description: Estimated traversal time, including configured connector delay.

checks: from_node_id != to_node_id; length_m > 0; expected_seconds > 0.
Both endpoint nodes belong to this map version; enforce composite endpoint FKs.
For a cross-floor edge, both endpoints must be stops of connector_id in this version.
Choose distance or time as one consistent route cost. An A* heuristic must be a lower bound in that same unit; use h=0 if no defensible bound exists.
Published geometry/costs are immutable. Temporary status changes are operational exceptions and trigger rerouting.

QR_CHECKPOINT.name: QR_CHECKPOINT
QR_CHECKPOINT.description: Stable printed QR destination, surviving map republishing.

columns.name: public_slug
columns.description: Unpredictable or descriptive public URL identifier; not a credential.

checks: Resolve the QR to an anchor in the currently published map. Never embed a version-specific node ID as the only permanent QR reference.

CHECKPOINT_ANCHOR.name: CHECKPOINT_ANCHOR
CHECKPOINT_ANCHOR.description: Version-specific pose and node attached to a stable QR checkpoint.

columns.name: yaw_deg
columns.description: Heading about the world z axis, using documented convention.

columns.name: marker_height_m
columns.description: Physical QR centre height above the floor when used for visual alignment.

checks: Composite primary key (checkpoint_id, map_version_id). Node version and checkpoint mall must match.
Scanning a URL supplies checkpoint identity. Camera pose recovery requires a supported visual anchor/alignment workflow; this row alone does not provide continuous tracking.

SHOP_ENTRANCE.name: SHOP_ENTRANCE
SHOP_ENTRANCE.description: Connects a physical shop unit to a version-specific entrance node.

columns.name: is_primary
columns.description: Default entrance for this unit in this version.

checks: At most one primary entrance per (shop_unit_id, map_version_id), using a conditional unique index.
Unit floor equals node floor; node version and mall must match.

FACILITY_ANCHOR.name: FACILITY_ANCHOR
FACILITY_ANCHOR.description: Connects a facility destination to a version-specific graph node.
checks: Composite primary key (facility_id, map_version_id); node floor/version/mall must match the facility.

AR_REFERENCE_ANCHOR.name: AR_REFERENCE_ANCHOR
AR_REFERENCE_ANCHOR.description: Optional visual target or VPS reference aligned to the local map.

columns.name: node_id
columns.description: Nearby routing node; pose below is the exact reference pose.

columns.name: reference_key
columns.description: Target asset key or provider reference identifier.

columns.name: x_m
columns.description: Anchor origin x in map coordinates.

columns.name: y_m
columns.description: Anchor origin y in map coordinates.

columns.name: z_m
columns.description: Anchor origin z in map coordinates.

columns.name: physical_width_m
columns.description: Measured target width, required for metric visual target alignment.

checks: Node belongs to map_version_id. Euler convention is intrinsic Z-Y-X; the runtime must convert from its own coordinate frame explicitly.
Physical width is positive for image/fiducial targets; provider calibration is separately required for a VPS reference.
An AR SDK/browser/device integration must be tested independently. LiDAR assets do not automatically provide browser localization.

ROUTE_SESSION.name: ROUTE_SESSION
ROUTE_SESSION.description: Optional saved route request for troubleshooting or opt-in analytics.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Optional signed-in user; avoid saving guest identity.

checks: Both nodes belong to the pinned map version.
Route computation may be stateless; do not persist ROUTE_SESSION/ROUTE_STEP unless this optional feature is enabled.

ROUTE_STEP.name: ROUTE_STEP
ROUTE_STEP.description: Ordered graph path in a saved route session.

columns.name: incoming_edge_id
columns.description: Edge from the previous step; null only at step zero.

checks: Composite primary key (route_session_id, step_no). Steps are contiguous from zero.
First/last node match the session endpoints. Each incoming edge connects the preceding node to this node in the pinned version.

PURCHASE.name: PURCHASE
PURCHASE.description: Recorded sale used as evidence; not a complete checkout/payment system.

columns.name: buyer_user_id
columns.description: Known buyer or null for a walk-in purchase.

columns.name: external_receipt_ref
columns.description: Shop receipt reference for idempotent import/entry.

columns.name: total_amount
columns.description: Final sale amount after line discounts; proposed baseline excludes separate tax/shipping.

checks: total_amount >= 0. A completed sale contains at least one item and total_amount equals its sum of line_total_amount.
Only authorized shop staff or a trusted import may record or complete a sale. This is a trust boundary, not bank/payment proof.
Partial refunds, payments, delivery, and checkout are outside this baseline.

PURCHASE_ITEM.name: PURCHASE_ITEM
PURCHASE_ITEM.description: Immutable record of the product listing and amount bought.

columns.name: line_discount_amount
columns.description: Total discount applied to this line.

columns.name: line_total_amount
columns.description: quantity times unit price minus line discount.

checks: quantity > 0; unit_price_amount >= 0; 0 <= line_discount_amount <= quantity * unit_price_amount.
line_total_amount = quantity * unit_price_amount - line_discount_amount. Listing shop and currency must equal purchase shop and currency.
After completion, keep snapshots immutable; later catalogue price/name edits do not rewrite history.

VERIFICATION_TOKEN.name: VERIFICATION_TOKEN
VERIFICATION_TOKEN.description: One rotatable opaque review credential per purchase line.

columns.name: purchase_item_id
columns.description: Line eligible for one verified product review.

columns.name: token_digest
columns.description: Digest of a cryptographically random secret; never the raw token.

checks: expires_at > issued_at. Issue only for a completed purchase.
Token issuance confirms issuer membership in the purchase shop. A token is not a public navigation QR.
Reissue by rotating the digest before redemption; old secrets immediately stop working. No rotation after redemption.
Do not generate predictable tokens from product ID plus a fixed mall key. The random secret is tied to purchase, listing, shop, and mall through database relationships.

TOKEN_REDEMPTION.name: TOKEN_REDEMPTION
TOKEN_REDEMPTION.description: Atomic, single successful claim of a purchase token by a user.

columns.name: verification_token_id
columns.description: Claimed token; primary key prevents second redemption.

checks: In one transaction, lock the token, verify digest, expiry/revocation and completed purchase, then insert the redemption.
If the purchase has buyer_user_id, it must equal the claimant. For an unbound walk-in purchase, the first valid holder claims it.
Possession of a leaked unbound token is a risk; keep secrets out of logs and URLs where practical.

REVIEW.name: REVIEW
REVIEW.description: Shared review content with a concrete shop target and optional listing target.

columns.name: shop_id
columns.description: Reviewed shop, including the seller of a reviewed product.

columns.name: shop_product_id
columns.description: Null for shop review; present for product-listing review.

checks: 1 <= rating <= 5. Listing, when supplied, belongs to shop_id; enforce a composite FK (shop_product_id, shop_id).
Unique (author_user_id, shop_id) where shop_product_id IS NULL. Unique (author_user_id, shop_product_id) where shop_product_id IS NOT NULL.
One persistent review per user/target; edits and withdrawals update the same review. Target and author are immutable.
Normal/verified is derived from REVIEW_VERIFICATION validity, not a user-editable boolean. Product reviews are shop-listing specific, not automatically global product scores.

REVIEW_VERIFICATION.name: REVIEW_VERIFICATION
REVIEW_VERIFICATION.description: Optional, unique binding between a product review and claimed purchase evidence.

columns.name: review_id
columns.description: Verified review; at most one evidence binding.

columns.name: verification_token_id
columns.description: Claimed token; cannot verify multiple reviews.

columns.name: revoked_at
columns.description: Verification withdrawn after refund/fraud or correction.

columns.name: revocation_reason
columns.description: Why evidence is no longer valid.

checks: Review must target a product listing. Review author equals TOKEN_REDEMPTION.user_id; purchased listing equals reviewed listing.
The baseline verifies product reviews only. A normal shop review has no REVIEW_VERIFICATION row.
Create/update review plus evidence binding transactionally. Binding is retained after withdrawal to prevent token reuse.
A refund/void/revocation removes eligibility for a current verified badge; preserve the historical evidence record.

REVIEW_REPLY.name: REVIEW_REPLY
REVIEW_REPLY.description: Public replies by authorized staff of the reviewed shop.
checks: Check active shop membership at write time; former membership does not erase historical authorship.

REVIEW_REPORT.name: REVIEW_REPORT
REVIEW_REPORT.description: A user report about one review.

MODERATION_ACTION.name: MODERATION_ACTION

columns.name: action
columns.description: publish, hide, restore, dismiss_report, or revoke_verification.

checks: Report, when supplied, references this same review.
Moderator must have permission for the reviewed shop mall. Record the action and update review/report state in one transaction.

USER_PREFERENCE.name: USER_PREFERENCE

columns.name: locale
columns.description: Language tag, such as en or bn.

columns.name: ar_preferred
columns.description: Preferred UI mode, subject to capability and consent.

checks: Missing row means application defaults. Guest preferences can remain local to the device.

FAVOURITE_SHOP.name: FAVOURITE_SHOP
FAVOURITE_SHOP.description: A shop saved by a user.
checks: Composite primary key (user_id, shop_id) prevents duplicates.

FAVOURITE_PRODUCT.name: FAVOURITE_PRODUCT
FAVOURITE_PRODUCT.description: A shop listing saved by a user, preserving seller context.
checks: Composite primary key (user_id, shop_product_id) prevents duplicates.

CONVERSATION.name: CONVERSATION
CONVERSATION.description: A customer or administrator conversation in one mall context.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Signed-in owner, or null for an anonymous session.

checks: An admin conversation requires an authenticated mall-authorized user. An anonymous conversation is public only.
Read access to anonymous conversations requires a server-issued session credential outside this logical content schema. IDs alone are not authorization.

CHAT_MESSAGE.name: CHAT_MESSAGE
checks: sequence_no >= 0. Do not expose hidden system instructions or secrets through user-facing history.

KNOWLEDGE_DOCUMENT.name: KNOWLEDGE_DOCUMENT
KNOWLEDGE_DOCUMENT.description: Controlled retrieval source with explicit mall and optional shop/listing scope.

columns.name: source_kind
columns.description: mall_guide, shop_profile, product_listing, faq, or admin_report.

columns.name: source_locator
columns.description: Controlled source URL or internal locator.

checks: If listing is present, shop_id is present and matches the listing; shop mall matches mall_id.
mall_guide/faq use neither shop nor listing; shop_profile uses shop only; product_listing uses both. admin_report is mall-scoped in this baseline.
Retrieval must filter by mall and access scope before sending context to a model.

DOCUMENT_REVISION.name: DOCUMENT_REVISION
DOCUMENT_REVISION.description: Immutable source content snapshot used to reproduce citations.

columns.name: source_updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp of the underlying source revision.

KNOWLEDGE_CHUNK.name: KNOWLEDGE_CHUNK
KNOWLEDGE_CHUNK.description: A retrieval-sized text segment from an immutable document revision.

CHUNK_EMBEDDING.name: CHUNK_EMBEDDING
CHUNK_EMBEDDING.description: Optional external vector-index record for a chunk and embedding model.

columns.name: index_record_key
columns.description: External index namespace/key; vector bytes live in that index.

checks: Composite primary key (chunk_id, model_key). dimensions > 0.
A search-only prototype can omit this table. A relational vector extension is an alternative physical implementation, not a second required store.

MESSAGE_CITATION.name: MESSAGE_CITATION
MESSAGE_CITATION.description: Evidence chunks attached to an assistant answer.

columns.name: retrieval_score
columns.description: Score whose interpretation depends on the retriever.

checks: Message role is assistant. Citation source mall/access scope must be permitted by the conversation and current user authorization.
Retain referenced revisions or an approved redacted evidence record for the conversation retention period.

MESSAGE_RECOMMENDATION.name: MESSAGE_RECOMMENDATION
MESSAGE_RECOMMENDATION.description: Ordered, structured product-listing recommendations in an answer.

columns.name: shop_product_id
columns.description: Recommended listing; shop is derived from this listing.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Short explanation grounded in source data.

checks: Listing belongs to conversation mall. Refresh availability/price from catalogue at display time.
Validate model-proposed IDs and ranking against database results; generated text must not create fictional inventory.

METRIC_DEFINITION.name: METRIC_DEFINITION
METRIC_DEFINITION.description: Meaning and formula version for each metric.

columns.name: definition
columns.description: Population, exclusions, aggregation, and time-boundary rules.

checks: Use a new metric code when the definition changes; never silently change historical semantics.

SHOP_METRIC_SNAPSHOT.name: SHOP_METRIC_SNAPSHOT
SHOP_METRIC_SNAPSHOT.description: Frozen shop metric for a specific observation period and calculation cutoff.

columns.name: metric_value
columns.description: Null when undefined or insufficient data.

checks: period_end > period_start; sample_size >= 0.
Store review count and rating mean separately; do not turn zero observations into a zero rating.
Separate shop-level and product-listing ratings in metric definitions; distinguish verified and unverified populations.

REPORT_RUN.name: REPORT_RUN
REPORT_RUN.description: One reproducible report request for a mall and period.

columns.name: requested_by_user_id
columns.description: Authorized requester; null for a configured scheduled job.

columns.name: source_cutoff_at
columns.description: Data cutoff used by the run.

columns.name: dataset_label
columns.description: real or demo; all report input snapshots and included forecasts use this label.

checks: period_end > period_start. Compute monthly boundaries in MALL.timezone, then store UTC instants.
Scheduled jobs execute with explicit service authorization; a null requester is not public permission.
dataset_label is real or demo. Every input snapshot and included forecast must use the same label; never mix them in one report.

REPORT_SHOP_SCOPE.name: REPORT_SHOP_SCOPE
REPORT_SHOP_SCOPE.description: Frozen list of shops included in a report run.
checks: Every shop belongs to the report mall. Record explicit rows even for an all-shops report.

REPORT_METRIC_SNAPSHOT.name: REPORT_METRIC_SNAPSHOT
REPORT_METRIC_SNAPSHOT.description: Exact immutable metric snapshots used in a report.
checks: Snapshot shop is in REPORT_SHOP_SCOPE; period, cutoff, and intended dataset label match report configuration.

REPORT_ARTIFACT.name: REPORT_ARTIFACT
REPORT_ARTIFACT.description: A generated downloadable output from a report run.
checks: size_bytes > 0. Access is authorized through the report mall before issuing a temporary download link.

FORECAST_RUN.name: FORECAST_RUN
FORECAST_RUN.description: Optional experimental regression run for one shop and metric.

columns.name: parameters_json
columns.description: Features, hyperparameters, preprocessing, and reproducibility details.

columns.name: evaluation_json
columns.description: Time-based holdout errors and sample counts.

checks: training_end > training_start. Future observations must not enter training or preprocessing.
Report insufficient data explicitly. Synthetic/demo forecasts are labelled and cannot substantiate real shop performance.

FORECAST_TRAINING_SNAPSHOT.name: FORECAST_TRAINING_SNAPSHOT
FORECAST_TRAINING_SNAPSHOT.description: Exact historical snapshots used to train a forecast run.
checks: Snapshot shop, target metric, and dataset label equal the run; each observation ends no later than training_end.
Choose one source cutoff per training period; do not train on multiple revised copies of the same observation.

FORECAST_POINT.name: FORECAST_POINT
FORECAST_POINT.description: Predicted value for one future period.

columns.name: predicted_value
columns.description: Point prediction in the target metric unit.

checks: period_end > period_start and period_start >= training_end.
Interval bounds are both null or both present with lower_bound <= predicted_value <= upper_bound; state interval confidence/method in run parameters.

REPORT_FORECAST.name: REPORT_FORECAST
REPORT_FORECAST.description: Optional forecast runs included in a generated report.
checks: Forecast shop belongs to REPORT_SHOP_SCOPE and dataset_label equals REPORT_RUN.dataset_label; clearly label forecast output separately from observed metrics.
